mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Prescribers by drug returns one row per doctor per drug, ranked - the flagship view. Provider totals returns one row per prescriber across every drug they wrote. Drug by geography returns national and per-state totals for a drug, with opioid and antibiotic flags.

brandName.title: Brand name
brandName.description: Brand drug name, for example Ozempic, Eliquis, Humira. Must match exactly, though capitalization does not matter. If nothing matches, the run returns free suggestions of real names.

genericName.title: Generic name
genericName.description: Generic ingredient name, for example Semaglutide, Apixaban. Exact match, capitalization does not matter.

state.title: State
state.description: Two letter state of the prescriber, for example TX or CA. In drug by geography mode this selects that state's totals instead of national.

specialty.title: Specialty
specialty.description: Prescriber specialty exactly as CMS records it, for example Cardiology, Endocrinology, Family Practice, Internal Medicine.

npi.title: NPI
npi.description: Ten digit National Provider Identifier, to pull one specific prescriber. Optional.

lastName.title: Prescriber last name
lastName.description: Prescriber last name or organization name. Exact match, capitalization does not matter. Combine with state to narrow common names.

year.title: Data year
year.description: Which program year to read. CMS publishes about 18 months behind, so the newest complete year is the default.

sortBy.title: Rank by
sortBy.description: Highest first. Total cost surfaces the biggest spenders, claims surfaces the highest volume prescribers.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Maximum rows to return, highest ranked first.
